text: 顶级经济学家表示，美联储应顶住特朗普的压力，进行三年多来首次加息，他们支持美联储主席沃什的观点，即央行必须专注于遏制通胀。芝加哥大学布斯商学院51名受访经济学家中有50人表示借贷成本应从当前3.5%-3.75%的区间上调。尽管多数经济学家支持加息25个基点，但14%的人呼吁大幅加息50个基点，因担心特朗普与德黑兰的战争引发的燃料价格飙升将演变为更广泛的通胀危机。得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校教授Olivier Coibion表示：“美联储在加息方面严重落后于曲线。通胀多年来一直远高于目标，通胀没有回落到目标的趋势；如果说有，也是在朝错误方向移动，因此政策应强力回
text_en: Top economists said the Federal Reserve should withstand pressure from Trump and raise interest rates for the first time in more than three years, supporting Federal Reserve Chairman Warsh's view that the central bank must focus on curbing inflation. Of 51 economists surveyed by the University of Chicago Booth School of Business, 50 said borrowing costs should be raised from the current 3.5%-3.75% range. Although most economists supported a 25-basis-point rate hike, 14% called for a substantial 50-basis-point hike due to concerns that the surge in fuel prices caused by Trump's war with Tehran will evolve into a broader inflation crisis. Olivier Coibion, a professor at the University of Texas at Austin, said: "The Federal Reserve is seriously behind the curve in raising interest rates.
